description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of the 'git grep' command with the '--open-files-in-pager' option and other related functionalities. It sets up various test scenarios, runs commands, and checks their outputs to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, running the provided shell commands and verifying their outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks the output of grep commands against expected results.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or checks configuration settings for the tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the current test to clean up or reset state.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, performing any final checks.
